news-sites.PROBLEM_TITLE: Commenting on News Sites Is Broken. Readers Know It.
news-sites.PROBLEM_P3: What news readers actually want is straightforward: they want to see comments appear in real time as a story develops, they want conversations that are moderated well enough to be worth reading, and they want to participate without surrendering their data to an advertising network. They want a comments section that respects both the story and the people reading it.
news-sites.PROBLEM_P1: Most commenting systems were built for blogs, not newsrooms. They load slowly, drag down page performance, and treat a local city council story the same as a national election thread drawing thousands of simultaneous readers. The result is a comments section that either feels dead or collapses under its own weight, neither of which serves your audience or your editorial mission.
news-sites.PROBLEM_P2: The cost of getting it wrong is measurable. Slow-loading comment widgets hurt Core Web Vitals, which directly impacts your search rankings and ad revenue. Toxic or spam-filled threads erode reader trust and create legal and reputational risk. Heavy third-party scripts inject trackers that conflict with your privacy obligations and undermine the editorial independence your readers expect. And every reader who abandons your comments section is a reader who takes their engagement, and their loyalty, to social media instead.
news-sites.WHY_FC_P2: During breaking news and major events like election nights, court rulings, and live sports, your traffic doesn't scale linearly, it spikes. FastComments handles <%- Number(usageStats.pageLoadCount).toLocaleString() %>+ page loads per year across its client base and supports millions of active comments without degradation. The infrastructure is built to absorb sudden, massive surges in concurrent readers and commenters. Your comments section stays responsive when it matters most.
news-sites.WHY_FC_TITLE: A Commenting System Built for the Speed of News
news-sites.WHY_FC_P1: FastComments was engineered for exactly the conditions news sites face daily. Comments appear instantly for every reader on the page, with no reload, no polling delay, and no stale threads. When a story breaks and your audience surges to weigh in, the conversation keeps pace with events in real time. This is not a bolt-on feature. Live commenting is the foundation of how FastComments works.
news-sites.MODERATION_TITLE: Moderation Tools Designed for Newsroom Volume
news-sites.WHY_FC_P3: Performance is not a secondary consideration. The entire FastComments widget ships at roughly 30 kilobytes, a fraction of what systems like Disqus load onto your pages. That difference is significant for news sites, where every kilobyte affects page load time, Core Web Vitals scores, and ultimately your position in search results. Faster pages mean better SEO, lower bounce rates, and more ad impressions. A lightweight commenting system for publishers is not a luxury. It is a competitive advantage.
news-sites.WHY_FC_P4: Integration is built for newsroom workflows. SSO lets your subscribers comment under their existing accounts. Webhooks push comment data into your CMS, analytics platforms, or moderation dashboards. Support for 14 languages with automatic detection means your international readership participates without friction. Whether you run a single metro daily or a network of publications across markets, FastComments fits the architecture you already have.
news-sites.MODERATION_P1: News site moderation operates under constraints that most platforms never consider. A political story can generate hundreds of comments in minutes, a significant share of which may be inflammatory, off-topic, or outright spam. You need moderation that works at that velocity without requiring a staff of twenty people watching threads around the clock. A slow or clumsy moderation system does not just cost time. It lets toxic content sit in front of your readers and your advertisers.
news-sites.MODERATION_P2: FastComments includes a machine learning spam classifier that catches automated spam and coordinated abuse before it reaches your audience. Beyond automated filtering, the moderation interface supports bulk actions like approving, rejecting, or flagging dozens of comments in seconds. Moderation groups let you assign different teams to different sections or topics. Your politics desk can moderate their threads independently from your sports editors, each with their own rules and escalation paths.
news-sites.PRIVACY_TITLE: Privacy That Matches Your Editorial Standards
news-sites.MODERATION_P3: The goal is civil discourse without silence. Heavy-handed moderation kills conversation. Absent moderation breeds toxicity. FastComments gives your team the precision tools to enforce community standards quickly while keeping the productive, substantive reader conversations that build audience loyalty and distinguish your publication from the noise of social media.

When a commenting system harvests user data or injects trackers, it creates a conflict between your editorial mission and your technology stack. Readers and regulators notice. FastComments removes that conflict entirely. Your comments section is a reader engagement tool, nothing more, and that clarity strengthens the relationship between your publication and your audience.

No third-party data brokers riding on your comment widget. Your readers interact with your content, not with a surveillance layer disguised as engagement software. Anonymous commenting is available for stories where source protection or reader safety matters.
news-sites.SCALE_P1: FastComments processes over <%- Number(usageStats.pageLoadCount).toLocaleString() %> page loads per year and supports millions of comments across its client base of more than <%- Number(Math.floor(usageStats.tenantCount / 100) * 100).toLocaleString() %> organizations. The infrastructure is purpose-built for high-concurrency environments where thousands of readers load the same story simultaneously. Response times remain consistent whether a thread has ten comments or ten thousand.
news-sites.SCALE_P2: Traffic spikes are not an edge case for news sites. They are the normal operating condition during any significant story. FastComments does not throttle, queue, or degrade during surges. There are no per-pageview pricing traps that penalize you for having a successful story. When your audience grows, your commenting system should keep up without sending you an overage invoice. With both fixed and flexible pricing plans, your costs stay predictable even when your traffic doesn't.
news-sites.MIGRATION_P2: There is no extended parallel-run period and no engineering project required. The typical migration takes minutes, not weeks. Your development team adds a lightweight script tag, configures your preferences, and your comments section is live with full history preserved.
news-sites.COMMUNITY_P2: Reader engagement on news sites competes directly with social media for attention and habit formation. The publications that win that competition are the ones that give their audience a reason to come back to the source. Analytics built into FastComments show you which stories drive the most engagement, which commenters are most active, and how your community is growing over time.
news-sites.CTA_SUBTITLE: No page slowdowns, no privacy trade-offs, no scaling surprises. See what FastComments looks like on your site with a free trial, no credit card required.
news-sites.CTA_TITLE: Your Readers Are Already Talking. Give Them a Better Place to Do It.
news-sites.COMMUNITY_P1: A comments section is the starting point, not the destination. FastComments includes awards and badges that recognize your most thoughtful contributors, reactions beyond simple upvotes, and built-in surveys that let you gauge reader sentiment on the issues you cover. Direct messaging between users lets conversations continue beyond individual threads. These are the tools that turn one-time commenters into regular participants and regular participants into loyal subscribers.
news-sites.MIGRATION_P1: Switching commenting systems sounds disruptive. In practice, FastComments imports your existing comments from Disqus, WordPress, and other platforms with a straightforward migration tool. Your existing threads, usernames, and conversation history transfer intact. Readers return to find their past comments exactly where they left them, and the transition is seamless enough that most will not notice the change, only the improvement.
news-sites.NEWSPACK_TITLE: FastComments Works With Newspack, Out of the Box
news-sites.NEWSPACK_P1: Newspack is built on WordPress, and so is the FastComments plugin. If you publish with Newspack, you do not switch platforms or rebuild anything. Install the FastComments WordPress plugin on your Newspack site, connect it in a few clicks, and live commenting is running in minutes. Your posts, your theme, and your editorial workflow stay exactly where they are.
news-sites.NEWSPACK_COMPARE_CAPTION: Newspack default comments compared with FastComments
news-sites.NEWSPACK_P3: You keep Newspack for everything it does well, publishing, membership, and your editorial operation, and FastComments takes over the conversation. It is fully GDPR compliant, it does not track or profile your readers, and it loads no advertising pixels onto your pages. The result is a comments section that matches the standards your newsroom already holds itself to, running on the platform you have already chosen.
news-sites.NEWSPACK_P2: Newspack ships with WordPress's native comments, and those comments carry every limitation WordPress brings with them. There are no real-time updates, so readers refresh the page to see new replies. The markup adds weight that drags down Core Web Vitals on article pages already heavy with ads and media. Spam protection is thin, and moderation means working through the wp-admin queue one comment at a time. On a breaking story drawing thousands of readers at once, that model does not hold up. FastComments replaces it with instant, live comments that appear as the conversation happens, at a footprint of roughly 30 kilobytes.

my-account-ai-agents.HEADING: AI Agents
my-account-ai-agents.INTRO_TEXT: AI agents watch for events in your community and respond. Give each agent a personality in its initial prompt, pick which events should trigger it, and it will use its available tools - posting comments, voting, moderating, awarding badges - to act on your behalf. FastComments uses AI providers that don't train on your data.

ai-agents.PAGE_TITLE: AI Agents for Comment Moderation | FastComments
ai-agents.META_DESCRIPTION: AI agents that read every comment, surface the hard calls, and reply in your voice. Dry-run mode, human approval queues, hard budget caps, EU DSA-ready audit trails. Built into FastComments.
ai-agents.HERO_SUBHEAD: Spin up agents that read every comment, surface the hard calls, and reply in your voice. Every action ships with a confidence score and the reasoning behind it. Launch new agents in dry-run when you want to watch first.
ai-agents.HERO_RUN_REASONING_VALUE: Comment lacks attack language but repeats a debunked claim. Soft warn aligns with community guidelines § 4.
ai-agents.HERO_RUN_FOOT: Every run captures the prompt, tools used, cost, and who approved what.
ai-agents.PILLARS_HEADING_SR: Six things every agent ships with
ai-agents.S1_BODY: Every agent can optionally launch in dry-run. Every destructive action - bans, mass deletes, IP blocks - can be gated behind a human approval queue. The agent only sees the tools you opt into. The rest don't exist as far as the model is concerned.
ai-agents.S1_BULLET_DRY_RUN: Disabled, dry-run, or enabled. Flip status without redeploying a prompt.
ai-agents.S1_BULLET_BAN_GRANULARITY: Granular ban powers. Opt in separately to deleting a banned user's history or banning by IP.
ai-agents.S1_BULLET_TOOL_ALLOWLIST: Per-agent tool allowlist. Disallowed tools are hidden from the model entirely, not just refused at runtime.
ai-agents.S1_BULLET_APPROVALS: Approvals queue with optional per-reviewer routing. Email the right person, not the whole team.
ai-agents.S1_BULLET_PROVIDERS: Models from providers that don't train on your data.
ai-agents.S2_BULLET_THREAD: Parent comment and prior replies in the same thread.
ai-agents.S2_BODY: An agent that only sees one comment will misjudge it. FastComments agents pull in the full thread, the commenter's history, the page they're commenting on, and any community guidelines you've written - then act on what they actually understand.
ai-agents.S2_BULLET_PAGE: Page title, subtitle, description, and meta tags.
ai-agents.S2_BULLET_USER: Trust factor, account age, ban history, and recent comments for the commenter.
ai-agents.S2_BULLET_GUIDELINES: Tenant community guidelines prepended to every prompt for consistent rule application.
ai-agents.S3_BODY: Pick the events that should wake an agent up. Pick the tools it's allowed to use when it does. Both lists are explicit, both are enforced. Optional delays let votes and reports settle before the agent looks.
ai-agents.S3_TRIGGER_DELAY: Optional delay up to 30 days before the agent runs
ai-agents.S4_BULLET_AGENT_CAP: Daily and monthly caps on each individual agent.
ai-agents.S4_BODY: Hard daily and monthly caps per agent and per account. Email alerts at every threshold you choose. When an agent hits its cap it pauses. No overage, no manual intervention.
ai-agents.S4_BULLET_TENANT_CAP: Account-wide rollups so one agent can't starve another.
ai-agents.S4_BULLET_ALERTS: Custom alert thresholds. Default is 80% and 100%; we recommend adding 50% for noisy agents.
ai-agents.S4_BULLET_RATE: Built-in rate limiting and concurrency caps with backpressure when the queue saturates.
ai-agents.S4_BULLET_DROPS: Skipped triggers are logged with the reason, so you know what you missed.
ai-agents.S5_BULLET_GUIDELINES: Tenant community guidelines drive moderation decisions. Your rules, your wording.
ai-agents.S5_BODY: Every agent action is recorded with the reasoning, confidence, transcript, cost, and reviewer. Every full ban in the EU region requires a human in the loop, locked on by us, not by you.
ai-agents.S5_BULLET_AUDIT: Per-run records: prompt, transcript, tools used, action taken, justification, reviewer.
ai-agents.S5_BULLET_DSA: EU DSA Article 17: full bans require human approval in the EU region. Locked on; cannot be turned off.
ai-agents.S5_BULLET_DISPLAY: Display names you control, distinguishing agent-authored comments from human-authored ones.
ai-agents.S5_BULLET_DRY_LIVE: Dry-run vs live counts in analytics so you can prove what's been automated and what hasn't.
ai-agents.S5_TIMELINE_T1_TEXT: Agent ToS Enforcer proposed Mark spam on c#9b1f8 - confidence 0.97
ai-agents.S5_TIMELINE_T2_TEXT: Reasoning: "Comment is verbatim copy of a known affiliate spam template; user account 8 minutes old."
ai-agents.S6_BODY: Spin a new agent up from a prebuilt template, then replay it against weeks of your historical comments to see what it would have done before turning it on.
ai-agents.S6_BULLET_REPLAY: Replay against the last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or any custom window up to 90 days.
ai-agents.S6_BULLET_TEMPLATES: Prebuilt templates for common moderation use cases. Created agents start in dry-run.
ai-agents.S6_BULLET_DELTAS: Replay results split into matches, deltas, no-action, and errors so you can focus on the disagreements.
ai-agents.S6_BULLET_COST_ESTIMATE: Cost estimate before you start; hard cap aborts the run if exceeded.
ai-agents.S7_BULLET_LOOP: Loop prevention so one agent's reply doesn't endlessly trigger another.
ai-agents.S7_BULLET_LOCKING: Per-comment execution locking. Two agents never trip over each other on the same comment.
ai-agents.S7_BULLET_RETRIES: Failed runs retry with bounded attempts before being marked errored. Never lost.
ai-agents.S7_BULLET_MODELS: Model choice per agent. Swap between cost-optimized and quality-optimized without rewriting prompts.
ai-agents.CUSTOMERS_SUBTEXT: AI agents are part of the FastComments platform. Sign up free, switch any agent to dry-run, watch what it would do, then go live.
ai-agents.FAQ_A_DRY_RUN: An agent in dry-run runs end-to-end against every matching trigger. It picks tools, generates reasoning, decides on an action, but the action is never executed. Every run is logged so you can review what it would have done before flipping it to enabled.
ai-agents.FAQ_A_MODELS: Today, GLM 5.1 (smarter, slightly slower) and GPT-OSS 120B Turbo (faster). Both are hosted by providers that don't train on your data. We add new models as the price-performance frontier moves.
ai-agents.FAQ_A_BUDGET: Each agent has its own daily and monthly cap, and your account has a rollup. When an agent crosses its cap, it pauses; alerts go out to billing admins at every percentage you've configured. Skipped triggers stay logged so you know exactly what was missed.
ai-agents.FAQ_A_REPLAY: Yes. The replay feature runs an agent against your historical comments, up to 90 days back, and shows you matches, deltas, and disagreements vs the prior outcome. You see the cost estimate before starting and can set a hard cap that aborts the run if it overshoots.
ai-agents.FAQ_A_EU_DSA: EU DSA Article 17 requires human review of user suspensions. In the EU region, the 'ban' tool is locked behind the approval queue and cannot be fully automated. It's a platform-level rule we enforce, not a setting you can disable. Every action is recorded with reasoning and reviewer for the audit trail.
ai-agents.FAQ_A_PROMPT: Each agent has an initial prompt that defines its personality and goals. You can also paste your community guidelines into the agent's context, and FastComments prepends them to every run so the agent applies your rules consistently.
ai-agents.FAQ_Q_PROMPT: Can I bring my own prompt and rules?
ai-agents.FAQ_Q_REPLAY: Can I test an agent before turning it on?
ai-agents.FINAL_CTA_SUB: Pick a template, point it at the triggers you care about, and turn it on when you're ready. No credit card required to sign up.

my-account-mcp-setup.HEADING: MCP Server Setup
my-account-mcp-setup.INTRO: FastComments exposes a stateless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI coding assistants and agentic clients call the FastComments API directly. Each tool maps to an existing public API endpoint and is generated from the OpenAPI spec, so anything the REST API can do, an MCP client can do.
my-account-mcp-setup.CHOOSE_KEY_HELP_PREFIX: The selected key is embedded in the generated URL and snippets. Manage keys on the
my-account-mcp-setup.WHAT_IS_MCP_BODY: Model Context Protocol is an open standard for letting LLM clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and others) invoke server-side tools. The FastComments server runs over HTTP, requires no session state, and authenticates every request with your existing API key.
my-account-mcp-setup.NO_KEYS_BODY: Create an API key before configuring an MCP client.
my-account-mcp-setup.ENDPOINT_HELP: Use this URL anywhere an MCP client accepts a streamable HTTP endpoint.

my-account-mcp-setup.CLAUDE_DESKTOP_HELP: Add this block to your client's MCP servers config (claude_desktop_config.json or Cursor's mcp.json).
my-account-mcp-setup.SNIPPET_WARNING: Contains your API key. Do not share publicly.
my-account-mcp-setup.DOCS_LINK_SUFFIX: for the full MCP integration overview.

webflow.FAQ_V2_SUBTITLE: Common questions about running FastComments on Webflow.
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_FREE_TRIAL_ANSWER: Yes. FastComments offers a 30-day free trial with full access to every feature, including live chat, reviews, and SSO. No credit card is required to start.
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_BILLING_ANSWER: The Webflow app is free to install. Webflow does not charge for it. You pay FastComments for your plan on your FastComments account, exactly as you would without Webflow, and you can change or cancel it there at any time.
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_CMS_ANSWER: Yes. Add a widget once on a CMS Collection Template and it appears on every item in that collection. Each published item gets its own comment thread, derived from the page path, with nothing to configure per post.
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_LOADER: Why do I add a loader script?
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_CMS: Does it work with the Webflow CMS?
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_GDPR_ANSWER: Yes. FastComments is GDPR compliant, offers EU data hosting, and provides tools for data export and deletion. Choose the EU region in the app to route the widgets through EU infrastructure.
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_SSO: Can I sign my own members in?
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_SSO_ANSWER: Yes. FastComments supports Single Sign-On so your logged-in members comment under their existing identities. You can also let visitors create their own FastComments accounts or comment anonymously.
webflow.FAQ_WEBFLOW_LOADER_ANSWER: Webflow's Designer can place an element on the canvas but cannot run the code that turns it into a live widget. The one-time loader script, added to your site footer, finds the widgets you insert and boots them on the published page. You add it once and it powers every widget.

django.HOW_IT_WORKS_SUBTITLE: Three steps to live comments in your Django app.
django.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_1_DESCRIPTION: Install the package from GitHub with pip. Add the api extra when you want server-side REST access.
django.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_2_DESCRIPTION: Add "fastcomments_django" to INSTALLED_APPS, then set the FASTCOMMENTS dict with your TENANT_ID and API_KEY.
django.FAQ_DJANGO_FREE_TRIAL_ANSWER: Yes. FastComments offers a 30-day free trial with full access to all features, including SSO, live chat, and the rich text editor. No credit card required to start.
django.FAQ_DJANGO_SSO: How does SSO work with Django auth?
django.FAQ_DJANGO_VERSIONS: Which Django and Python versions are supported?
django.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_3_DESCRIPTION: Load the tag library in any template, then drop in the comments widget wherever you want the thread.
django.FAQ_DJANGO_VERSIONS_ANSWER: The FastComments Django package supports Django 4.2, 5.0, 5.1, and 5.2, and requires Python 3.10 or higher. It installs as a standard Django app with a single entry in INSTALLED_APPS.
django.FAQ_DJANGO_SSO_ANSWER: When Secure SSO is enabled, the package reads the authenticated user from the request and signs an HMAC-SHA256 token on the server. This creates or updates the user's FastComments account with their name, email, and avatar, so users are signed in without extra registration. Map fields with USER_MAP, a to_fastcomments_user_data() method on your user model, or a global USER_MAPPER. Choose the SSO id deliberately: it is the permanent handle for a user's comment history, so map it to a stable, opaque value like a UUID rather than a sequential primary key.
django.FAQ_DJANGO_GDPR_ANSWER: Yes. FastComments is fully GDPR compliant with an optional EU-based CDN that keeps all data within Europe. Set REGION to "eu" in the FASTCOMMENTS settings and the package routes widgets and API calls to the EU region. We support data export requests, right-to-deletion, and provide a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) on request.
django.FINAL_CTA_DESCRIPTION: Install the package, load the tag library, drop in a template tag, and go live in minutes.
django.FINAL_CTA_TITLE: Ready to Add Comments to Your Django App?
django.FAQ_DJANGO_CUSTOMIZE: Can I customize the widget markup?
django.FAQ_DJANGO_API: Can I access the FastComments API from Django?
django.FAQ_DJANGO_CUSTOMIZE_ANSWER: Yes. Override the fastcomments/widget.html template by placing your own copy earlier on the template search path. Every tag also accepts standard FastComments configuration options as keyword arguments, giving you full control over appearance and behavior without editing the package.
django.FAQ_DJANGO_API_ANSWER: Yes. Install the api extra and the package exposes the FastComments Python SDK: admin() for authenticated calls, public_api() for public calls, and get_manager() for signing SSO tokens. Use them to create, update, or delete comments, manage users, fetch analytics, and more from your views or background jobs.

wordpress.PAGE_TITLE: WordPress Comments Plugin - Live, Private & Spam-Free | FastComments
wordpress.HEAD_KEYWORDS: wordpress comments plugin, wordpress commenting system, fastcomments wordpress, disqus alternative wordpress, wordpress live comments, replace wordpress comments, wpdiscuz alternative, jetpack comments alternative
wordpress.META_DESCRIPTION: Replace slow, ad-filled WordPress comments with FastComments. Real-time comments served from a global CDN to take the load off your server, sign-in with your existing WordPress accounts, spam protection, and one-click Disqus import. Free trial.
wordpress.SPIDER_SUBTITLE: A complete replacement for WordPress, Disqus, Jetpack, and wpDiscuz comments - with none of the ads or data harvesting.
wordpress.OFFLOAD_TITLE: Take the Load Off Your Server
wordpress.OFFLOAD_CDN_DESCRIPTION: Comments load from FastComments' global CDN instead of querying your WordPress database on every page view. Your server does less work and your pages stay quick.
wordpress.OFFLOAD_SUBTITLE: A big reason sites switch: FastComments hosts and serves every comment from its own global infrastructure, so your WordPress server stays fast - even when a post takes off.
wordpress.OFFLOAD_SCALE_DESCRIPTION: From 100 comments to 100,000, FastComments handles storage, moderation, and real-time delivery - with no extra database load and no slowdowns during traffic spikes.
wordpress.OFFLOAD_SYNC_DESCRIPTION: Want a local copy? Optionally sync your comments into your WordPress database - continuously, or as a one-time export - so you always have your data and can cancel without losing a thing.
wordpress.SSO_SUBTITLE: Pick how readers sign in - keep it frictionless, or let them use the WordPress account they already have.
wordpress.SSO_SECURE_FEATURE_1: Comment with just a name and email
wordpress.SSO_SECURE_DESCRIPTION: Readers start commenting instantly - no account required. This is how FastComments ships, and it drives the most participation.
wordpress.SSO_SIMPLE_DESCRIPTION: Turn on Single Sign-On so your members comment with the WordPress account they already have - no second registration.
wordpress.HOW_IT_WORKS_TITLE: Set Up in a Few Clicks
wordpress.HOW_IT_WORKS_SUBTITLE: Install the plugin and follow the setup wizard - no code, and no API keys to copy.
wordpress.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_2_DESCRIPTION: The setup wizard links WordPress to FastComments in a couple of clicks. Create a free account or connect an existing one, and choose whether your data lives globally or in the EU.
wordpress.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_1_DESCRIPTION: Add FastComments from the WordPress plugin directory and activate it. There is nothing to code.
wordpress.HOW_IT_WORKS_STEP_3_DESCRIPTION: FastComments imports your existing comments and takes over commenting on your posts - hosted on our infrastructure so your WordPress server stays fast. Prefer a local copy? Optionally sync comments back to WordPress anytime.
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_SERVER_LOAD: Will this reduce load on my WordPress server?
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_SERVER_LOAD_ANSWER: Yes - that's one of the main reasons sites switch. FastComments stores and serves comments from its own global infrastructure, so your WordPress server no longer queries the database and renders comment threads on every page view. The widget loads asynchronously from a CDN, which is especially valuable on high-traffic posts.
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_MIGRATE: Can I import my existing WordPress or Disqus comments?
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_KEEP_DATA_ANSWER: Always. FastComments hosts your comments so they don't weigh down your server, and you can optionally sync them back into your WordPress database - continuously, or as a one-time export before you cancel. Nothing is ever locked away.
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_SEO: Will switching to FastComments affect my SEO?
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_KEEP_DATA: Do I still own my comments?
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_MIGRATE_ANSWER: Yes. The setup wizard includes a one-click import that brings over your existing WordPress comments - including nested threads, author information, and timestamps. Imports from Disqus, Hyvor, and other systems are supported too, and avatars and images migrate automatically.
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_FREE_TRIAL_ANSWER: Yes. Start a free trial with full access to every feature - no credit card required. After that, pricing is based on your monthly page views and starts well under $5/month for most sites, with no per-comment fees.
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_SEO_ANSWER: No. FastComments renders comments server-side - even without JavaScript - so search engines can still crawl and index your comment content. You can also optionally sync comments into your WordPress database if you want a local copy as well.
wordpress.FINAL_CTA_TITLE: Ready to Upgrade Your WordPress Comments?
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_GDPR: Is FastComments private and GDPR compliant?
wordpress.FAQ_WORDPRESS_GDPR_ANSWER: Yes. FastComments never shows ads, never harvests or sells visitor data, and sets only the functional cookies needed for login - so no cookie banner is required for FastComments specifically. Keep all of your data in the EU on eu.fastcomments.com, and a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is available on request.
wordpress.FINAL_CTA_DESCRIPTION: Install the plugin, connect your account, and go live in minutes. Faster pages, zero ads, zero data harvesting, and none of the server load of native WordPress comments.

demo.META_DESCRIPTION: Try live FastComments demos including commenting widgets, ratings, SSO, anonymous commenting, badges, dark mode, WYSIWYG editor, and more.
demo.HERO_DESCRIPTION: FastComments is packed with features, but don't let that fool you. With every release we've kept the our commenting product free of bloat. Try out the live demo below.
demo.DEMO_SELECTOR_SUBTITLE: FastComments supports many different use cases. Try one below!
demo.OUR_CUSTOMERS_SUBTEXT: No Credit Card Required For Initial Sign up & Installation
demo.DEMO_OPTION_RATINGS_ABOUT: Here we have two widgets. The summary widget, and the commenting widget. We've added some questions in the dashboard under Customize->Questions and added a widget configuration under Customize->Customize which uses our questions. We've setup the widget configuration to only apply to this page, as well, but you could setup questions to show on all pages or a specific subdomain.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_SSO_ABOUT:
Here we're using the FastComment Secure SSO solution. This makes an API call when you select the button to get the user's information which is hashed against an API with an SHA-256 hash for verification. The code is very similar to this.

FastComments also supports what we call Simple SSO, which doesn't require a server.

With both solutions we can configure if the user is a moderator, an admin, add custom labels, badges, notification preferences, etc.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_ANON_ABOUT: In this example we've turned on a few settings. We enabled anonymous commenting, but this alone would still show the email input field and just make it optional. We've also hidden the email input field and allowed anonymous voting and flagging. This was all configured via the admin dashboard, no code written.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_BADGES_ABOUT:
FastComments supports what we call badges, which are awarded to users automatically based on various conditions. There are three badges you can earn here:
  • Curious: Awarded for commenting on this page.
  • Very Curious: Awarded for commenting on this page more than once. Configured to replace the Curious badge.
  • Night Owl: Awarded for commenting on this page at night.
  • Well Liked: Awarded when you receive 5 or more total karma on this page.
These will automatically be applied to your account and shown. You can hide them by going to you profile (click your avatar) and clicking the three-dot menu and clicking Manage Badges. This will only work in a fully authenticated verified session and not an anon session.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_DARK_MODE_ABOUT:
In this example we turn on dark mode for the whole page. The commenting widget automatically detects the DOM tree it is in contains a dark background and adjusts.

You can use an API to configure this behavior as well.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_LIKES_DESC: Use likes instead of up/down votes.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_CODE_SNIPPETS_DESC: FastComments supports dev communities by auto-detecting code snippet languages and formatting them.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_CODE_SNIPPETS_ABOUT:
Some communities, for example Stack Overflow, promote sharing of code between developers. FastComments is designed to fit in these communities by gracefully handling code snippets while sanitizing content to prevent against XSS or style attacks.
You can learn more about the security of the comment area here.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_WYSIWYG_DESC: Rich text editor for easier commenting.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_WYSIWYG_ABOUT:
The WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) editor provides a rich text editing experience for users who prefer visual formatting over markdown. It includes common formatting options like bold, italic, links, and lists while maintaining the security and performance standards of FastComments.

This is particularly useful for non-technical communities where users might not be familiar with markdown syntax. This example also enables the resize handle.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_TOS_ABOUT:
This demo shows the Terms of Service checkbox that can be required for first-time commenters. When enabled, anonymous users see the checkbox on every comment, while authenticated users only see it on their first comment or when you update your TOS.

You can customize the checkbox text per locale and set a "Last Updated" date to force users to re-accept when your terms change.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_AI_AGENTS_ABOUT: This is a demo of our AI Agents feature. An agent is configured to periodically summarize the comments and leave a comment and pin it. Additionally, another agent is configured to send you a welcome email the first time you comment here (if you haven't commented on any of our other demos yet). An AI agent is also configured to do general moderation.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_AI_AGENTS_DESC: Thread summarization using AI Agents, along with some other AI Agent features like welcome emails.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_USER_LIST_ABOUT: Renders a list of people on this page beside the comment widget. The Online Participants section shows everyone currently viewing in real time; the Offline Participants section lists past commenters when usersListIncludeOffline is enabled. Configurable to render as a top facepile, a left sidebar, or a right sidebar.
demo.DEMO_OPTION_USER_LIST_DESC: Show a sidebar of online viewers and past commenters next to the widget.

index.FEATURE_MCP_SERVER_MODAL_INTRO: We host a Model Context Protocol server, so Claude, Cursor, and any other agentic client can work with your account directly.
index.FEATURE_MCP_SERVER_MODAL_B2: Your dashboard generates a pre-filled URL and ready-to-paste config for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Cursor.
index.FEATURE_MCP_SERVER_MODAL_B1: Every tool is generated from our public OpenAPI spec, so anything the REST API can do, your agent can do.

marketing_common.FAQ_CAN_MIGRATE: Can I migrate my data from my existing solution?
marketing_common.FAQ_CAN_MIGRATE_ANSWER: All plans support automated self-service migration from a selection of major providers. We perform custom migrations.
marketing_common.FAQ_CUSTOMIZE_UI: Can we customize the UI of the comment widget?
marketing_common.FAQ_CUSTOMIZE_UI_ANSWER: Yes, the comment widget is designed to be customized.
marketing_common.FAQ_EXISTING_ACCOUNTS: What if my users already have accounts? They have to have an account to comment now too?
marketing_common.FAQ_EXISTING_ACCOUNTS_ANSWER: FastComments supports SSO, which means that your users can have one login for your site/application, and commenting.
marketing_common.FAQ_REQUIREMENTS: Does FastComments require anything special on my site to run?
marketing_common.FAQ_REQUIREMENTS_ANSWER: No, our commenting widget has no dependencies.
marketing_common.FAQ_CUSTOMER_SERVICE_SLAS: What are your customer service SLAs?
marketing_common.FAQ_CUSTOMER_SERVICE_SLAS_ANSWER: We generally respond within an hour during business hours, and 24 hours at most. There is a ticketing system within the admin area.
marketing_common.FAQ_CANCEL_MYSELF_ANSWER: You can cancel without any intervention from customer support, although we'll reach out to hear what we could have done better!
marketing_common.FAQ_TRIAL_ENDS: What happens when the trial ends?
marketing_common.FAQ_TRIAL_ENDS_ANSWER: The comment widget will still function for a short time, and then hide itself. You and your users will still have full access to the admin area. You will receive reminders, which you can easily opt out of, when the trial ends.
marketing_common.FAQ_EXCEED_LIMITS: What if I exceed the limits of my account?
marketing_common.FAQ_EXCEED_LIMITS_ANSWER: All package details, except for number of comments per month, are hard limits. If you exceed the number of comments per month, we'll reach out to you to negotiate your package. On the Flex plan, you set your own limits from the Billing page to cap your monthly spend.
marketing_common.FAQ_FREE_TIER: I run an open source project with low traffic, is there a free tier?
marketing_common.FAQ_FREE_TIER_ANSWER: There is currently no official free tier, however for example adding comments to OSS documentation pages we make exceptions. Simply create a support ticket after signing up.
marketing_common.FAQ_ADD_USERS: Can I add my developers, moderators, and other admins?
marketing_common.FAQ_ADD_USERS_ANSWER: Yes, FastComments supports adding other users to your account and controlling their permissions.
marketing_common.FAQ_COOKIE_BANNER: Do I need to add a cookie banner to my site?
marketing_common.FAQ_COOKIE_BANNER_ANSWER: You are not required to add a cookie banner on your site if you use FastComments. We only add functional cookies for logging in, and do not add any tracking cookies or cookies that would personally identify your user, to your site.
marketing_common.FAQ_COMMENT_BOX_LIMIT: Is there a limit on the number of comment boxes I can have?
marketing_common.FAQ_COMMENT_BOX_LIMIT_ANSWER: FastComments does not bill on the number of comment boxes, or threads, that you may have. There is no limit today, either. We instead bill on traffic and comment volume.
marketing_common.FAQ_SEO_INDEXABLE: Are comments indexable via search engines?
marketing_common.FAQ_SEO_INDEXABLE_ANSWER: Yes, we ensure that comment threads can be indexed by search engines. Learn more
marketing_common.FAQ_ALL_WIDGETS: Do I get access to all widgets on all places?
marketing_common.FAQ_ALL_WIDGETS_ANSWER: Yes. All plans include all widgets (live commenting, live chat, small widgets, etc).
marketing_common.FAQ_DATA_STORAGE: What countries is my data stored?
marketing_common.FAQ_DATA_STORAGE_ANSWER:
We have different deployments for different use cases. By default, FastComments globally replicates all data to many continents.

We do not have any servers in China. We have a node in Singapore for our customers in that region.

For our EU customers, if your account resides on eu.fastcomments.com, data stays in the EU.
marketing_common.FAQ_BILLING_SCHEDULE: What is the billing schedule for Flex?
marketing_common.FAQ_BILLING_SCHEDULE_ANSWER: You are billed at the end of every month based on your usage, not on the signup date.
marketing_common.FAQ_PAY_YEARLY_ANSWER: You can pay yearly for the non-flex billing plans.
marketing_common.FAQ_CHARGE_MODERATORS: So you charge based on how many moderators and admins I have?
marketing_common.FAQ_CHARGE_MODERATORS_ANSWER: Yes, to make pricing easier for small and large companies, we pay for admin and moderator seats. We usually offer bulk pricing for very large organizations.
marketing_common.FAQ_TWO_SITES: What if I have two sites, how am I billed?
marketing_common.FAQ_TWO_SITES_ANSWER: Some packages like the Creators plan include up to 3 sites. The Flex plan gives you the first one free, so with two sites you'd pay a total of $10/mo, but it also includes de-branding which Creators does not.
marketing_common.FAQ_SUBDOMAIN: What if I have mysite.com and subdomain.mysite.com?
marketing_common.FAQ_SUBDOMAIN_ANSWER: This depends on the setup. If you add mysite.com to your account, it would be billed as one, and the data/comments are still stored separately. However, let's say you want specific configuration for subdomain.mysite.com - then you'd have to add it separately in your account and it'd be billed as such.
marketing_common.FAQ_MISSED_PAYMENT_ANSWER: The system gives you a grace period of a week to pay unpaid invoices, and then your account will be paused. Unpaid accounts are deleted after a year.
marketing_common.PUBLIC_NAV_ITEM_AI_AGENTS_DESC: Moderation that shows its work. Dry-run, audited, capped.
marketing_common.PUBLIC_NAV_ITEM_WEBFLOW_DESC: Add comments from the Webflow Designer.
marketing_common.PUBLIC_NAV_ITEM_COMMENTING_API_DESC: REST API and SDKs for live discussions.
marketing_common.FAQ_FLEX_SPEND_LIMIT: Can I set a spending limit on Flex?
marketing_common.FAQ_FLEX_SPEND_LIMIT_ANSWER: Yes. On the Billing page in your dashboard, enter a target monthly maximum and we'll set the matching usage limits for you, or fine-tune each limit yourself. Usage that would exceed a limit is blocked, which caps what you're billed.

my-account-customize-email-template.TEXT_DOMAIN_NOTE_CANNOT_BE_SPECIFIC: This template may be shown in the context of multiple domains at once (for example, multiple comments in the same email notification), or may not be in the context of a domain at all. For this reason, this template cannot be domain-specific.
my-account-customize-email-template.TEXT_LOCALIZATIONS_INFO: Translations are customized on a per-locale basis, as users may comment and speak in different languages. Select the locale you want to customize the translations for.
my-account-customize-email-template.TEXT_CUSTOMIZE_FROM_NAME_EMAIL: Looking to customize the From Name and From Email? Do that here.
my-account-customize-email-template.TEXT_TEST_DATA_INFO: Here you can define custom test data used in preview. It is saved along with the template.

my-account-customize-email-template-dele.TEXT_CONFIRM_DELETE: Are you sure you want to delete the template <%= template.displayName %>, created on <%= template.createdAt.toLocaleString() %>?

my-account-customize-email-templates.TEXT_CUSTOM_TEMPLATES_INFO: Here you can define custom email templates for each type of email we send to your users.
my-account-customize-email-templates.TEXT_SEPARATE_TEMPLATES_INFO: You can define separate templates for each site, if desired.
my-account-customize-email-templates.TEXT_MULTIPLE_ALL_DOMAINS_WARNING: Warning! You have multiple templates set to render for All Domains. Only the first one will be used.
my-account-customize-email-templates.TEXT_RENDER_ERRORS_NOTE: This means the template failed to send recently due to errors in the syntax.
my-account-customize-email-templates.TEXT_NO_CUSTOM_TEMPLATES: No custom templates for this email.

my-account-customize-widget.TEXT_NO_CUSTOMIZATIONS: You don't have any customizations for your widgets!

my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_CUSTOMIZE_INTRO_1: You've come to the right place if you want to make FastComments look like your own.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_CUSTOMIZE_INTRO_2: These settings will affect how FastComments looks on your site. You can define these customizations as "rules" - a rule can apply to a whole domain or a single page.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.HEADING_WHAT_SITE_TO_CUSTOMIZE: What site do you want to customize?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DOMAIN_NOTE: This is optional. Select All Domains and the rules will apply to all sites. Don't see your site listed? Add it here.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_URL_ID_NOTE_1: This is optional. Leave it blank or enter * and the rules will apply to all pages.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_URL_ID_NOTE_2: Patterns are also supported! For example you could have */blog/* in one configuration and */store/* in another.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.OPTION_AUTOMATIC: Automatic (detect light or dark site background)
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_AUTOMATIC_NOTE: Automatic styling will detect your site's color scheme and attempt to match it. If the site is dark, we'll enable dark mode, for example.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_FORCE_DARK_NOTE: Force Dark Mode will mean your site must have a dark background, otherwise text may be unreadable.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_FORCE_WRAPPED_NOTE: Force Wrapped will put the comment widget in a container with a white background to isolate it from your site.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_NEVER_WRAP_NOTE: Never Wrap is like Auto but only Dark Mode. We'll never put the widget in a container with its own background.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_COMMENT_COUNT_FORMAT_NOTE: Use [count] to represent the localized comment count.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_HIDE_AVATARS_NOTE: Even if someone has an avatar, it won't show next to their name.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_GIF_RATING_NOTE: When image uploads are allowed, this controls the rating of gifs shown in the Gif Picker.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_IMAGE_PROFANITY_NOTE: Controls the level of profanity moderation for uploaded images.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_PROFANITY_LOW: Low: Blocks explicit sexual and violence content
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_PROFANITY_MEDIUM: Medium: Also blocks hate, harassment and self-harm content
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_BLOCKING_NOTE: Do not allow users to block other users. Does not affect existing blocked users.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.LABEL_INPUT_AFTER_COMMENTS: Move reply box to the bottom of the page?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_INPUT_AFTER_COMMENTS_NOTE: Want people to read the comments before replying?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_CLICK_TO_SHOW_COMMENTS_NOTE: Hide the comment list and the comment box under a link?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_USE_SHOW_COMMENTS_TOGGLE_NOTE: Click to show comments, with the ability to show a number of comments by default. Shows the comment box by default.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_COUNT_ABOVE_TOGGLE_NOTE: How many comments should we show above the "Show Comments" button?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_PREVENT_NEW_REPLIES_NOTE: Enabling this will disable commenting, but show previous comments, for the defined site/url.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_PREVENT_NEW_ROOT_COMMENTS_NOTE: Enabling this will disable creating new top-level comments, but allow replying to existing comments.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_COLLAPSE_LIVE_COMMENTS_NOTE: Enabling this will collapse "live" comments under a "Show X New Comments" button. Otherwise, new live comments will show normally as they are added.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_LIVE_COMMENTING_NOTE: Enabling this will turn off all live features. Clients will not show live updates to the comment feed, votes, comment changes (edits, deletes), and result of moderation actions.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.LABEL_REQUIRE_SSO: Require SSO To View Comments
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_REQUIRE_SSO_NOTE: Enabling this will require commenters to be logged in via SSO (single-sign-on) to view the comment widget. Does not apply to the site admin.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_SSO_SECURITY_LEVEL_NOTE: Choose Simple SSO for third party integrations, Secure SSO for custom server-based integrations.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.LABEL_LIMIT_COMMENTS_BY_GROUPS: Limit Comments by SSO User Groups
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_LIMIT_COMMENTS_BY_GROUPS_NOTE: With this enabled, users will only see comments from their same access groups.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_COMMENTER_LINKS_NOTE: Enabling this will show a field for entering a website or blog URL when commenting. The commenter's username then links to this URL.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_SINGLE_LINE_COMMENT_INPUT_NOTE: Enabling this will change the multi-line comment input field into a single-row input.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.LABEL_COLLAPSE_REPLIES: Collapse Replies to Top-Level Comments by Default
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_COLLAPSE_REPLIES_NOTE: Enabling this will require users to click "Show Replies" to see child comments.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_WYSIWYG_NOTE: Enables WYSIWYG editing which allows formatting text without using visible anchor tags.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_RESIZE_HANDLE_NOTE: Allows users to resize comment input areas by dragging the corner.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_SPOILERS_NOTE: Adds a "SPOILER" button to the editor toolbar.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_TOOLBAR_NOTE: The comment reply toolbar, commonly called a WYSIWYG toolbar, will not show. Users will not be able to make text bold, for example, or upload images.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_VOTING_NOTE: Users will not be able to vote, and existing vote counts will be hidden.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_VOTE_STYLE_NOTE: When the heart icon is enabled, down voting is not possible and also validated server-side.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_VOTE_LIST_NOTE: Show users' names when hovering over comment vote counts.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_COMMENTER_COMMENT_DELETE_NO: Commenters will not be able to delete their comments.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_COMMENTER_COMMENT_EDIT_NOTE: Commenters will not be able to edit their comments.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_AUTO_HASHTAG_CREATION_NOTE: New hash tags will not be automatically bolded. A list of hash tags will have to be provided instead, to enable hash tags. The list of tags can also be maintained via the API.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_NOTIFICATION_BELL_NOTE: The notification bell tells users when someone has replied to them, or replied in a thread they are active in, and more. It can also be used to subscribe to a page.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_PROFILES_NOTE: Disables opening the user's profile when you click on their avatar.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_SHOW_BADGES_IN_TOP_BAR_NOTE: Shows user badges next to their username in the comment reply top bar.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DEFAULT_SORT_DIRECTION_NOTE: This will set the default sort direction of the comments. Users can still change it after the comments load.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_LOCALE_OVERRIDE_NOTE: This will set the locale for the comment widget, no matter what the user's browser is set to.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_PAGE_SIZE_NOTE: This will set the number of comments per-page. Upon changing, it may take several minutes to update all comment threads.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.OPTION_NAME_FORMAT_CAPITALIZE: Capitalize (display example user as Example User)
my-account-customize-widget-edit.OPTION_NAME_FORMAT_LAST_INITIAL: Last Initial (display Example User as Example U.)
my-account-customize-widget-edit.OPTION_NAME_FORMAT_ALL_INITIALS: All Initials (display Example User as E. U.)
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_COMMENTER_NAME_FORMAT_NOTE: Names are masked server-side to protect users.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_COMMENT_THREAD_DELETION_MODE_NOTE: What should the behavior be when deleting a comment that has replies?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_THIRD_PARTY_COOKIE_BYPASS_NO: This will cause a popup to be opened to fetch their fastcomments.com cookie when they comment, as a workaround for strict browser settings that block third-party cookies.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_VIEW_COUNTS_NOTE: Enables a live updating count next to each comment that increments when a user views a comment. Comment view counts are only tracked once this is enabled.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_AUTO_ADMIN_MIGRATION_NOTE: Disables automatic admin sync for SSO. Useful for WordPress sites where SSO is enabled and you don't want your WP admins to become FastComment admins or moderators.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_SUCCESS_MESSAGE_NOTE: Disables message that shows after submitting a comment.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_SHOW_QUESTION_NOTE: Read more about collecting feedback here
my-account-customize-widget-edit.OPTION_WHEN_SAVE_ON_ANSWER: On Answer (don't wait for full review)
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_WIDGET_QUESTION_RESULTS_STYLE_NOTE: How to show each user's ratings, if at all.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_WIDGET_QUESTION_NOTE: Create a question to show via Customize -> Questions. Sub-questions will be shown as well if they are configured as part of the selected question.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_RESTRICT_EXTERNAL_LINKS_NOTE: Restrict users to only linking to these sites.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ALLOWED_SITES_NOTE: Enter comma separated list of domains, or sites, that users can link to.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ALLOWED_LANGUAGES_NOTE: Comments will only be allowed to be posted in these languages.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_MAX_COMMENT_SIZE_NOTE: This will limit how long of a comment can be written, excluding image URLs.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_MAX_COMMENTS_PER_MINUTE_NOTE: How many comments can non-admin users create per minute?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DEFAULT_AVATAR_NOTE: The image that shows when a user doesn't have an avatar defined.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_COMMENTS_NOTE: Anonymous comments will always show as unverified.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_PREVENT_REMOVAL_NOTE: To prevent them from being removed configure your Moderation Settings here.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_HIDE_EMAIL_INPUTS_NOTE: Users will never have to enter their email to comment or vote.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DEFAULT_USERNAME_NOTE: The default value of the username input field.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_VOTES_NOTE: Votes will be able to be left without being logged in, or providing a username and email.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_FLAGGING_NOTE: Users will be able to flag comments without being logged in.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_HIDE_UNVERIFIED_COMMENT_LABEL_NOTE: Read more about comment verification here
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_USE_ABSOLUTE_DATES_NOTE: This will show dates like "<%= new Date().toLocaleString() %>" instead of "just now".
my-account-customize-widget-edit.LABEL_USE_BOTH_RELATIVE_AND_ABSOLUTE: Use both relative and absolute dates?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_USE_BOTH_RELATIVE_AND_ABSOLUTE_NOTE: This will show dates like "just now (<%= new Date().toLocaleDateString() %>)" instead of "just now".
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_COMMENT_HTML_RENDERING_MODE_NOTE: Comments are rendered into HTML, and a small safe subset of HTML is supported. We do things like strip too many newlines, large headings, and scripts. You may also choose to render links in raw text instead of an HTML link element to deter spammers.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_SPAM_RULES_NOTE: Define custom rules to automatically flag content as spam or not spam based on text matching.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.LABEL_ENABLE_TOS: Require Terms of Service acceptance for first-time commenters
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_TOS_NOTE: When enabled, new commenters must accept your Terms of Service before submitting their first comment.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.PLACEHOLDER_TOS_TEXT: I agree to the Terms of Service
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_TOS_LAST_UPDATED_NOTE: When set, users who accepted before this date will need to accept again.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_TOS_CUSTOM_TEXT_NOTE: Leave empty to use the default text for this locale.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_WIDGET_QUESTION_SHOW_BREAKDOWN_NOTE: After a user answers, show an aggregated breakdown of all responses for this page.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_PROFILE_COMMENTS_NOTE: Hides the profile comments tab when viewing a user's profile from the widget.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_DISABLE_PROFILE_DIRECT_MESSAGES_NOT: Hides the direct messages tab when viewing a user's profile from the widget.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_MENTION_AUTOCOMPLETE_MODE_NOTE: Controls which users appear in the mention autocomplete dropdown. Admins and moderators can still appear in the By Page and By Site sections but won't be highlighted as admins or mods.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.AI_ASSISTANT_SUBTITLE: Describe what you want. I will adjust the form for you.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.AI_ASSISTANT_DISABLE_PROMPT_TITLE: Hide the assistant on this device?
my-account-customize-widget-edit.AI_ASSISTANT_GREETING: Hi. Tell me what you want to change about this widget and I'll update the page. I can change settings and the widget appearance. Ask me about a setting if you are not sure what it does. Chat is sent to our AI provider, DeepInfra, and we will not train on your data.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.AI_ASSISTANT_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is not available right now.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.AI_ASSISTANT_DISABLE_PROMPT_BODY: If you choose to hide it, the assistant will not appear again on this browser until you clear your storage.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.AI_ASSISTANT_ERROR_TOKEN_BUDGET: You have reached today's usage limit for the assistant. Please try again tomorrow.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.AI_ASSISTANT_ERROR_GENERIC: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_USERS_LIST_LOCATION_NOTE: Show people who have commented on the page or are currently viewing it. Top renders an overlapped row of avatars above the comments. Left and Right render a sidebar with names and online indicators.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ENABLE_FCHAT_NOTE: Enabling this lets fastcomments.com users join this site as a chat server in the FChat desktop app. They can browse pages, read comments, and post replies in real time.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_USERS_LIST_INCLUDE_OFFLINE_NOTE: When enabled, the users list also includes people who have commented on the page but are not currently online. Default: only currently-online viewers are shown.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ALLOW_EMBEDS_NOTE: Lets commenters embed videos and players (YouTube, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Spotify, and more) by pasting the provider's iframe. Only trusted providers are allowed.
my-account-customize-widget-edit.TEXT_ALLOWED_EMBED_DOMAINS_NOTE: Comma separated list of extra embed hostnames to allow in addition to the built-in trusted providers.

my-account-delete.TEXT_PRIVACY_POLICY_NOTE: If you are deleting your account due to privacy concerns, consider checking our Privacy Policy. We do not sell or share your data with third parties.
my-account-delete.TEXT_ACCOUNT_OWNER_WARNING: You are an account owner. Deleting your account deletes this tenant.
my-account-delete.TEXT_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELLED: Your subscription will also be cancelled.
my-account-delete.TEXT_NO_SELL_DATA: Note that FastComments does not sell or share your personal information with third parties. We offer free account creation simply as a convenience.
my-account-delete.LABEL_CONFIRM_REMOVAL: Check this box to confirm your account removal. Deleting your account or associated comments can't be undone.
my-account-delete.LABEL_FEEDBACK: Help us understand why we're seeing you go.

my-account-delete-success.TITLE: Removal Succeeded
my-account-delete-success.HEADING: Goodbye!
my-account-delete-success.DESCRIPTION: The username you used is now available, meaning someone else can take it. However your comments have been removed.

my-account-digest-email-comment-approved.HEADING: Success!
my-account-digest-email-comment-approved.COMMENT_APPROVED: That comment has been marked reviewed and approved.
my-account-digest-email-comment-approved.VIEW_COMMENT_ON_SITE: You can view the approved comment on your site here, or using the comment thread viewer here.
my-account-digest-email-comment-approved.CLOSE_PAGE: You can now close this page.

my-account-digest-email-comment-marked-a.COMMENT_HIDDEN: The comment has automatically been hidden from your site.
my-account-digest-email-comment-marked-a.CLOSE_PAGE: You can now close this page.

my-account-digest-email-expired.CLOSE_PAGE: You can now close this page.

my-account-digest-email-unsubscribed-suc.HEADING: Unsubscribed

my-account-digest-email-unsubscribed-suc.CLOSE_PAGE: You can now close this page.

my-account-edit-details.TITLE: Edit Account Details - FastComments
my-account-edit-details.HEADING: Account Details
my-account-edit-details.EMAIL_VERIFIED_SUCCESS: Success! Your email has been verified.
my-account-edit-details.VERIFICATION_EMAIL_SENT: Sent email verification email. Check your email inbox at <%- user.pendingEmail %> for a link to complete the process.
my-account-edit-details.DISPLAY_NAME_HELP: This is used on your comments instead of your username.
my-account-edit-details.EMAIL_PENDING_VERIFICATION: This email is pending verification. The email <%- user.email %> is still used.
my-account-edit-details.WEBSITE_URL_HELP: Your username will link to this in comment threads. Note that not all communities have this feature enabled.
my-account-edit-details.BIO_HELP: This will appear on your public profile. Maximum 500 characters.
my-account-edit-details.COUNTRY_HELP: This will display a flag emoji on your profile.
my-account-edit-details.ERROR_RATE_LIMITED_MINUTE: You have exceeded our rate limits. Please try again in a few minutes or reach out to support.
my-account-edit-details.ERROR_RATE_LIMITED_DAY: You have exceeded our daily rate limits. Please try again in 24 hours or reach out to support.
my-account-edit-details.LOCALE_HELP: Choose your preferred language for the interface and notifications.

my-account-edit-details-change-password.TITLE: Change Password - FastComments
my-account-edit-details-change-password.HEADING: Change Password
my-account-edit-details-change-password.REQUEST_LINK_QUESTION: Would you like to request a link by email to set a new password?
my-account-edit-details-change-password.SUCCESS_MESSAGE: Success! We sent you a link to change your password.
my-account-edit-details-change-password.FAILURE_MESSAGE: Something went wrong. Please try again later. If this persists please reach out to support.

my-account-edit-details-change-password-.TITLE: Change Password - FastComments
my-account-edit-details-change-password-.HEADING: Change Password
my-account-edit-details-change-password-.PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH: Min password length is six characters.
my-account-edit-details-change-password-.SUCCESS_MESSAGE: Success! Your password has been changed.
my-account-edit-details-change-password-.INVALID_LINK_MESSAGE: Oh no! It looks like this password reset link is invalid. Note that they can only be used once.
my-account-edit-details-change-password-.FAILURE_MESSAGE: Something went wrong. Please try again later. If this persists please reach out to support.

my-account-edit-notifications.TITLE: Configure Notifications - FastComments
my-account-edit-notifications.HEADING: Notifications Settings
my-account-edit-notifications.REPLY_NOTIFICATIONS_HELP_TENANT: Includes notifications about new comments, as well as replies to your own. We'll also send notifications when you're tagged. You can control how often you receive these per subscription below.
my-account-edit-notifications.REPLY_NOTIFICATIONS_HELP_USER: Notifications when you're tagged or replied to.
my-account-edit-notifications.ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS_HELP: This includes admin-only notifications, like notifications about new comments, and notices regarding your account.
my-account-edit-notifications.DIGEST_DESCRIPTION: We can send you a reminder for comments you may have to review or approve on a regular schedule, as well as counts for:
my-account-edit-notifications.DIGEST_SCHEDULE_HELP: We'll send you a summary email on this schedule.
my-account-edit-notifications.LANGUAGE_HELP: The language that emails should be translated in.
my-account-edit-notifications.SUBSCRIPTIONS_DESCRIPTION: Here you can manage your page subscriptions. To be notified of new comments on a page, click the bell on a comment widget and click "Subscribe".
my-account-edit-notifications.NO_SUBSCRIPTIONS: You don't have any subscriptions yet.
my-account-edit-notifications.NOTIFICATION_FREQUENCY_HELP: How often you receive email notifications for new comments and replies to your comments. @mention notifications are always sent right away.
my-account-edit-notifications.REPLY_NOTIFICATION_FREQUENCY_HELP: How often you receive email notifications for replies to your comments. @mention notifications are always sent right away.
my-account-edit-notifications.TENANT_NOTIFICATION_FREQUENCY_HELP: How often you receive email notifications about new comments on your site.
my-account-edit-notifications.AGENT_APPROVAL_FREQUENCY_HELP: How often you receive email notifications when an AI agent queues an action for your review.

my-account-get-code.TITLE: My Account Code
my-account-get-code.HEADING: Comment Widget Code

my-account-get-code.EXTENSION_LINK: Comments not showing? Try our Chrome Extension.

my-account-get-code.CODE_TABBED_DEMO_TEXT: Script is for demo purposes only. To get a snippet for production, create an account.

my-account-help.TITLE: Help - FastComments
my-account-help.HEADING: Customer Service

 You should check out the support page of the site you are commenting on.

my-account-manage-data-webhooks.HEADING: Webhooks
my-account-manage-data-webhooks.PRODUCTION_NOTE_1: Ensure that you verify the "token" parameter in the request. This will be populated with your API secret, available here.
my-account-manage-data-webhooks.PRODUCTION_NOTE_2: When an invalid token is provided, return 401 Unauthorized.
my-account-manage-data-webhooks.PRODUCTION_NOTE_3: When a valid token is provided, return 200 OK.

my-account-manage-data-webhooks.PRODUCTION_NOTE_5: Note that events are not immediate. There may be up to a minute delay as our system is asynchronous.
my-account-manage-data-webhooks.PRODUCTION_NOTE_6: If you do not return a 200 OK status code we will try again after minute. The delay increases by a minute after each failure for that event.

my-account-managed-tenants-create.INTRO_PARAGRAPH_1: Creating a managed tenant allows you to manage the tenant from your parent account. This is useful for reselling FastComments, or providing isolated accounts to your clients.
my-account-managed-tenants-create.INTRO_PARAGRAPH_2: You don't need to do this to use FastComments. However, if you want to have multiple sites and completely isolate each site with its own moderators and users, it can be useful to have them as their own tenants.

my-account-managed-tenants-create.WEBSITE_ADDRESS_DESCRIPTION: No need to input subdomains or localhost. For multiple sites, separate them with commas.
my-account-managed-tenants-create.LIMITS_AND_PRICING_DESCRIPTION: With FastComments, you can customize the available packages to the tenant on a per-tenant basis. The below is populated by default with the limits and pricing of this parent tenant. Currently, you must bill your customer outside of FastComments. We will bill you based on their usage if you are on a Flex plan, or a flat rate on the Pro plan. You can find the pricing for this here.
my-account-managed-tenants-create.USAGE_LIMITS_DESCRIPTION: Limits are limited to the values of the current tenant. You may raise these by working with support. You may want to lower these values to limit what the managed tenant can do.

my-account-moderate-comments-settings.HEADING: Comment Moderation Settings
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.ENABLE_PROFANITY_DETECTION_DESCRIPTION: Comments are checked for profanity in real-time. Does not affect comments by administrators or moderators.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.AUTO_SEND_PROFANE_TO_SPAM_LABEL: Automatically Send Profane Comments to Spam
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.AUTO_SEND_PROFANE_TO_SPAM_DESCRIPTION: Instead of being masked, profane comments (determined via the phrase blacklist) will be hidden and marked as spam.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.ALLOW_PROFANE_NAMES_DESCRIPTION: When enabled, commenter names will not be checked for profanity or masked.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.ENABLE_SPAM_DETECTION_DESCRIPTION: Spam detection happens in real-time. Comments that look like spam will be hidden. Moderators can review and approve them as needed. Admins and moderator comments are excluded.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.BLOCK_SPAM_DESCRIPTION: Instead of allowing comments that look like spam, and approving them later, block them and tell the user to change their comment. The comments will not be submitted for moderation. For sites where the spam volume is too high to moderate.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.SPAM_FILTER_DESCRIPTION_BAYES: With Naïve Bayes, you can use the spam filter everyone else uses, or isolate your spam filter training to just your tenant. Both continuously learn.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.SPAM_FILTER_DESCRIPTION_LLM_AVAILABLE: Select an LLM option for AI-powered spam detection (billed $<%= (tenantPackage.flexLLMCostCents * 10000 / tenantPackage.flexLLMUnit).toFixed(2) %> per 1M tokens). Only non-obvious spam is sent to the LLM to reduce costs.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.SPAM_FILTER_DESCRIPTION_LLM_UNAVAILABLE: LLM-based spam detection is available for Flex (custom packages available).
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.AUTO_APPROVE_COMMENTS_DESCRIPTION: Changing this setting will not affect past comments.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.ONLY_AUTO_APPROVE_VERIFIED_DESCRIPTION: Unverified comments won't show for anyone. Changing this setting will not affect past comments.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.ONLY_AUTO_APPROVE_APPROVED_USERS_LABEL: Only Auto Approve For Approved Users
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.ONLY_AUTO_APPROVE_APPROVED_USERS_DESCRIP: With this, manual approval is required for the user's first comment. If a user has had a comment approved before, then their comment won't require manual approval.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.AUTO_REMOVE_UNVERIFIED_DESCRIPTION_1: This will happen daily at 12AM PST.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.AUTO_REMOVE_UNVERIFIED_DESCRIPTION_2: Manually approved, unverified comments, will not expire.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.UNVERIFIED_TTL_LABEL: How long should we keep unverified comments?
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.UNVERIFIED_TTL_DESCRIPTION: Unverified comments are checked for removal daily at 12AM PST.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.REPEAT_COMMENT_ACTION_DESCRIPTION: Optionally prevent spammers and abusive users from posting repeat comments.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.AUTO_UNAPPROVE_FLAGGED_DESCRIPTION: Comments can be hidden if enough users flag them.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.FLAGGED_THRESHOLD_LABEL: How many times should a comment being flagged result in it being un-approved?
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.FLAGGED_THRESHOLD_DESCRIPTION: Comments will be-unapproved after reaching this threshold. Being un-approved means it will not show.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.FUTURE_COMMENTS_NOTE: Changing these settings will only affect future comments.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.SPAM_PROFANITY_BLOG_LINK: Read more about FastComments Spam and Profanity filtering here.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.COPY_TO_SUB_TENANTS_DESCRIPTION: Checking this will copy the settings to all sub tenants.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.LLM_CONTEXT_DESCRIPTION: Provide additional context to help the LLM make better spam detection decisions for your site.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.LLM_CONTEXT_PLACEHOLDER: E.g., 'We are a gaming forum, references to violence are usually in-game discussion'
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.TRY_AI_AGENTS_MESSAGE: Try using AI Agents for moderation which can provide a better experience.
my-account-moderate-comments-settings.REPEAT_COMMENT_MIN_LENGTH_DESCRIPTION: Comments shorter than this many characters are not checked for repeats. Leave at 0 to check every comment (recommended, catches spam like repeated single characters). Increase this (e.g. to 10) if you run webinars or Q&A where short repeated comments like "yes" or "no" are expected.
